an4.71:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti. yoni cassa āraddhā hoti. āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.71:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
an4.71:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti, yoni cassa āraddhā hoti, āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
